verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs describe event-driven automations that act without user prompting: triggers that draft replies, add team comments, or organize threads into todos when emails arrive, and custom AI filters written in plain English that automatically label, star, or archive mail. The Tasklet integration also claims to act on emails automatically. The evidence consists of brief changelog and marketing lines, and no hands-on report confirms that these automations run reliably unattended. missing for 10: detailed documentation of trigger setup, execution and monitoring; recurring/scheduled (time-based) automations beyond the one-off scheduled send; logs or controls for background runs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.
Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
Shortwave now integrates with Tasklet to take action on your emails automatically.
